public_reference: check_reweighting 54ef2a62, feature organization only; no private extractor or weights
native_record: Pythia signed statuses, original mother/daughter lists, px py pz E mass float64; original LHE record and consumed ordinal
partons: QCD abs(id)<=6 or id=21, abs(native status)71..79, pT>=10GeV, exclude Z/H descendants, keep terminal selected parton copies. MPI included; status63 remnants excluded. All preselection indices retained separately.
jets: anti-kT R0.4, all stable particles except Z/H descendants, pT>=10GeV; legacy jets pT>30GeV; native constituents retained
kt: kT R1 E-scheme, true selected partons or replacement radiation jets; exclusive_dmerge(n) n=0..7 in GeV^2, -1 when n>=number inputs; leading inclusive jets pT>=10GeV for count/DeltaR
tensor_axes: pf_features N,7,L; pf_vectors N,4,L; pf_mask N,1,L; event_features N,5; ps_encoding_features N,19
tokens: fixed slots Z,H,leading two direct Z charged-lepton/neutrino children (legacy ancestry dressed), then pT ordered radiation; missing slots masked; type 1Z 2H 3charged 4neutrino 5jet 6parton
capacity_status: storage caps; inspect first real-shard occupancy and freeze final training schema before fits; complete raw records retained
ps_encoding_features: log1p(n kt jets), DeltaR leading pair or -1, valid pair, log1p(max(dmerge,0)/GeV^2)[8], valid dmerge[8]
normalization: stored physical/log features; no fitted preprocessing. Any standardization must be fitted only on training partition
weights: signed physical weights outside classifier feature dictionary; nominal2000 when present, scale ratios retain original nominal denominator
split: Zll only if replay matches complete legacy shard and every mZ in 15..150: local accepted row%5 source folds, row%2 target halves; omitted-shard lengths 5000/2500 multiples5/2. Zvv prospective identical convention
